hints.title: Calculate Absolute Difference
hints.text: Compute the difference between target goal and current sum of nums using 64-bit integers.

hints.title: Greedy Maximum Step Size
hints.text: Each added element can alter sum by at most limit; greedily add elements with magnitude limit.

hints.title: Ceil Division Formula
hints.text: The minimum number of elements needed is ceil(abs(goal - sum) / limit) = (diff + limit - 1) // limit.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating additions one by one takes O(diff / limit) time which is too slow when diff is 10^14.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Closed form ceil division evaluates answer in O(1) time and space after initial O(n) sum.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses 64-bit integer types to prevent overflow when summing nums.
